js-times-table.alternative: function timesTable(size){const out=[];for(let r=1;r<=size;r++){const row=[];for(let c=1;c<=size;c++)row.push(r*c);out.push(row);}return out;}
js-times-table.wrong-cap: function timesTable(size){const out=[];size=Math.min(10,size);for(let r=1;r<=size;r++){const row=[];for(let c=1;c<=size;c++)row.push(r*c);out.push(row);}return out;}
js-times-table.wrong-cache: const tableCache=new Map();function timesTable(size){if(tableCache.has(size))return tableCache.get(size);const out=[];for(let r=1;r<=size;r++){const row=[];for(let c=1;c<=size;c++)row.push(r*c);out.push(row);}tableCache.set(size,out);return out;}
